name: IPW Championship
epitaph: The fed's own title history lists five reigns of the IPW Championship, from 1 July 2005 to 9 April 2008, with the title twice retired for the fed's closings and once more on its last night, and a footnote saying it was renamed the UCW Championship while UCW held it in 2005.
notes: The page's footnotes record that the title was retired three times: when UCW closed in 2005, when IPW closed in November 2006, and on the last night in April 2008.

name: IPW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The fed's own title history lists three reigns of the tag titles, all between 25 July and 7 November 2006, ending with the belts retired when IPW closed in November 2006.
notes: The page does not number a team's members beyond the parenthetical in its holder cell; two holders are named as pairs without a team name.

name: IPW Pure Championship
epitaph: The fed's own title history lists one reign of the Pure Championship, won on 9 April 2008, the fed's last night, when the title was retired; its About page gives the title's own rules: three five-minute rounds, no pinfalls, a win by submission or a ten count, and a title change allowed on a disqualification.
notes: The fed's own rules page for it sets out three five-minute rounds, no pinfalls and a win by submission or a ten count.
